newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom launches 10 bln esc 5-yr bond.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom launches 10 bln esc 5-yr bond.

text.p: Portugal Telecom is launching a 10 billion escudos five-year bond with a coupon of 7.10 percent that could be redefined one year and three years after the liquidation date, said Banco ESSI, leader and bookrunner.
The coupon rate of this Callable Lisbor Reset Bond is 7.10 percent and liquidation takes place on November 22 1996.

The issuer has the right, two working days before the first redefinition date (one year after the liquidation date), to opt for one of the following rates to remain in force during the remaining four years of the life of the bond:
1. New fixed rate equal to 12-month Lisbor in force on that day plus 0.60 percent;
2. Maintain a fixed interest rate of 7.10 percent.

The issuer has the right, 18 days before the second redefinition date (three years after the liquidation date), to transform the issue to a variable rate issue, indexed to six-month Lisbor in force on the penultimate day of the previous interest rate period minus 0.10 percent.
